safety_verdicts.content: Patient has no past medical history of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not state the patient has no past history of anaphylaxis; they only state no current signs of anaphylaxis on exam (Assessment-001), which is not the same as past history.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the negative history of prior anaphylaxis removes a key risk-stratifying detail for an insect sting with reported dyspnea/lip symptoms; a subsequent clinician may treat the history as unknown and escalate evaluation or management unnecessarily. This is unlikely to directly cause injury but can lead to extra monitoring/referral and reduced clinical clarity.

The most likely impact is inefficiency or unnecessary escalation rather than direct harm.
